public_payload.normalized_proposition: If an AI-related economic debacle occurs during Trump's term, he will be closely tied to it because of his closeness to Silicon Valley.
conditions: if an AI-tinged economic debacle happens on his watch

statement.excerpt: And because he has become so tight with Silicon Valley he will also be closely tied to any AI-tinged economic debacle that happens on his watch.

from_speaker: because he has become so tight with Silicon Valley
he will also be closely tied to
our_interpretation: 'On his watch' means during Trump's current term, ending 2029-01-20.
'AI-tinged economic debacle' plainly means a major market crash, recession, or financial crisis widely linked to AI (for example, an AI bubble bursting).
'Closely tied' would be shown by mainstream reporting and polling that link the debacle to Trump and his AI or Silicon Valley policies.
criteria.support_condition: An AI-linked economic debacle occurs before 2029-01-20, and mainstream reporting and polling widely tie it to Trump and his closeness to the tech industry.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An AI-linked economic debacle occurs before 2029-01-20, but reporting and polling largely do not tie it to Trump.
